target_text: Navy TBFs (VT 10) from Enterprise, with VS 10, VMSB-132, coast artillery and USS Meade, sink four beached Japanese transports off the northern coast of Guadalcanal
notes: Cressman, 15 November 1942: Navy SBDs (VS 10) and TBFs (VT 10), USMC SBDs (VMSB 132), Marine and Army coast artillery, and gunfire from destroyer Meade (DD-602) sink four Japanese merchant transport/cargo ships off the northern coast of Guadalcanal (Kinugasa Maru, Hirokawa Maru, Yamazuki Maru, and Yamura Maru). The mission is embarked and is validated by the Air Group 10 relation and Enterprise claim C13137 (option b; last carrier pin 26 October, relation still open). Confidence 0.7: one official Navy chronology (mission rubric). The target place is Ironbottom Sound (kind area), not a sea_position.
